question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

 EBULLIENT
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3) Spirited**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Ebullient"** means full of energy, enthusiasm, and cheerfulness. (उत्साही)
 
 
• **Example:** She was ebullient after winning the competition.
 
 
• The correct synonym, **"Spirited"**, refers to showing enthusiasm, energy, or determination. (जोशीला)
 
 
• **Example:** The spirited debate lasted for hours as both teams passionately presented
